pairs.note: Key requires not less than 2% of aggregate Capital Commitments of the Partnership and Parallel Funds; answer states 1.0%. Different value. Answer also omits the condition that the commitment not be funded through a Management Fee waiver.

Both give a 12-year base term from the Final Closing Date, but key allows up to two one-year extensions (first at GP discretion, second requiring Advisory Committee consent) for a 14-year maximum; answer states three consecutive one-year extensions all at GP discretion. Wrong number of extensions, missing the Advisory Committee consent condition, and a different maximum term.
